name: Silkscreen Legibility Check
blurb: whether text height and stroke width are under a fab's minimum
intro: Checks legend text against a fab's published minimum line width and text height, and checks the height-to-stroke ratio (5–8 : 1 reads well; below 4 : 1 the letters fill in).

inputs.label: Stroke width
inputs.help: Line width of a stroke font (KiCad 'thickness').

examples.title: 40 mil text, 6 mil stroke at PCBWay

usage: Give the fab (jlcpcb, pcbway, generic, fine or custom with its limits), the units (mm or mil), the text height and the stroke width, and the font type (stroke, ttf, ttfbold). It returns a verdict, each value against the fab minimum, the height:stroke ratio, the smallest legible height and a suggested stroke, plus a table of common sizes. Use it before ordering boards or when setting default refdes sizes.
sources: JLCPCB and PCBWay published PCB capability pages (legend line width and character height)
Height:stroke ratio 1:6 recommendation from JLCPCB; KiCad default text 1.0 mm / 0.15 mm; ratio bounds are a rule of thumb
